simulation_partition.digital_domain: calibration controller and all future detection/margin/alarm logic
simulation_partition.reason: Preserve the validated mixed-signal methodology and avoid unnecessary full-transistor simulation of the digital controller.

PD_SENSE.supply_behavior: explicit analog supply that may vary or droop
contents: complete frozen FTC sensor delay/tuning network
PD_SENSE.boundary_output: Q_FINAL after the sensor capture DFF
PD_SENSE.architectural_rule: XOR and capture DFF remain in PD_SENSE. Moving either across the boundary changes the validated sensor transfer function and requires a dedicated architecture-change/root-cause plan.

PD_CTRL.simulation_supply_model: electrically abstracted; timing-valid digital standard-cell domain
contents: Q double sampler and classification logic
future detection FSM and alarm/status logic

PD_CTRL_to_PD_SENSE.current_verification_abstraction: XA D2A crossings whose analog high level is normalized to the sensor-local VDD
PD_CTRL_to_PD_SENSE.next_stage: PD1 must define real physical level-shifter/receiver requirements without modifying the frozen startup-calibration semantics.

PD_SENSE_to_PD_CTRL.semantic_type: latched state, not the XOR pulse or two raw timing paths
PD_SENSE_to_PD_CTRL.next_stage: PD1 must define a robust return receiver/level conversion path and its threshold/delay requirements.

boundary_rationale: The already validated transistor sensor contains the delay network, XOR network and capture DFF under one sensor supply.
Keeping XOR in PD_SENSE avoids adding two timing-critical cross-domain paths whose skew would corrupt the measured path-delay difference.
Keeping the capture DFF in PD_SENSE converts a short timing event into a held Q_FINAL state before the power-domain crossing.
The PD_CTRL double sampler remains the trusted digital decision layer; the sensor capture DFF is part of the transducer rather than the final security decision logic.
This boundary maximizes reuse of completed RF6/RF9C/RF9D evidence and avoids unnecessary re-characterization.
explicit_non_claims: The existing XA D2A/A2D elements are not proof of a fabricated or signed-off physical level shifter.
PD_CTRL power integrity under a physical implementation is not modeled by the current digital abstraction.
The current freeze does not characterize deep-droop failure of the PD_SENSE capture DFF; that belongs to future detection operating-region characterization.
No UPF/CPF or physical power-grid implementation is claimed by this contract.
